sidebar.emptyBody: Bots you create appear here. Make one and tell it the job: it writes its own instructions from your answer.
sidebar.emptyGroup: No bots in this group yet.

landing.note: A new bot gets a name and asks for its job. Tell it, and it sets itself up; change anything later in its settings.

chat.helloBlank: {{name}} is ready. Tell it what job to do.
chat.hello: {{name}} is ready. What should we work on?
chat.noKey: {{provider}} has no key in this workspace yet. Add one to talk to this bot.
chat.failedUnknown: The turn ended without saying why.

failure.rate_limit: {{provider}} is limiting requests for now. This usually passes: try again in a moment.
failure.usage_limit: The {{provider}} account is out of quota or credit. Sending it again won't help until it is topped up or the plan resets.
failure.credential: {{provider}} refused the key or sign-in. Sending it again won't help: check it in Model providers.
failure.refused: {{provider}} refused this request. Sending it again won't help: change the message or the model.
failure.unavailable: {{provider}} could not be reached. This is usually temporary: try again in a moment.
failure.time_limit: This turn ran out of time. Sending it again won't help: ask for a smaller step, or split the request.
failure.interrupted: This turn was interrupted before it finished. Sending it again runs it.

images.notSupported: {{name}} isn't an image a bot can read. Use a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP.
images.tooMany: A message can carry up to {{max}} images.
images.noVision: {{model}} can't read images. Switch the bot's model to send them.
images.noVisionHeld: {{model}} can't read images. Remove them or switch the model to send this message.
images.uploading: Wait for the images to finish adding.
images.failedHeld: Remove the image that couldn't be added.

research.name: Research a topic
research.prompt: Search the web and give me a short summary, with sources, of

summarise.name: Summarise something
summarise.prompt: Summarise this in five bullet points:

draft.name: Draft a message
draft.prompt: Draft a short, friendly message to

research.name: Research assistant
research.description: Finds and sums up what I ask about
research.prompt: Be my research assistant: when I name a topic, search the web and give me a short summary with its sources.

writing.name: Writing partner
writing.description: Tightens my drafts in my own voice
writing.prompt: Be my writing partner: tighten what I write, suggest clearer wording and keep my tone.

planner.name: Planner
planner.prompt: Be my planner: break my goals into steps, keep a to-do list and tell me what to do next.

news.name: News digest
news.description: The latest on what I follow
news.prompt: Be my news digest: when I ask, search the web for the latest on the topics I follow and sum it up in five bullets.

auto.label: Approve for me
auto.description: Edits files and runs commands without asking.

full.label: Full access
full.description: Everything, unattended, on the bot’s home host.

approval.title: {{name}} wants to do this
approval.detail: It runs once, as you, when you approve. Writing to {{name}} instead dismisses the request.
approval.notePlaceholder: Optional: why not, or what to do instead
approval.sharesOutside: This sends what it writes outside Oppenheimer, in your name.

goal.stopped: Goal “{{objective}}” stopped: a turn of it failed or was stopped

routineReason.expired: it waited too long to start
routineReason.automation_rate_limited: it reached its hourly run limit
routineReason.workspace_rate_limited: the workspace reached its hourly run limit
routineReason.missed: its time passed while it could not run
routineReason.bot_provider_missing: the bot’s model provider has no key or sign-in
routineReason.owner_lost_access: its owner can no longer run it

goal.title: Goal: {{objective}}
goal.stopFailed: Could not stop the goal. Try again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Who the bot is and where it sits in the sidebar.
profile.name: Name
profile.descriptionPlaceholder: What it does, in a line
profile.groupHint: Where it appears in the Employees sidebar
profile.clearBody: Every message of this chat is erased, with any request still waiting on you. The bot keeps its soul, instructions and memory.
profile.clearFailed: Could not clear the chat history.
profile.showsInHint: Sidebars that list it, beside Employees
profile.showsInFailed: Could not save where the bot shows.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.subtitle: The two files the bot reads before every message.
instructions.instructionsHint: Rules it follows on every task
instructions.conflict: {{file}} was saved somewhere else while you edited it, and is at revision {{revision}} now. Reload to see it; copy your text first if you want to keep it.
instructions.historyFailed: Could not load the revision history.

memory.title: Memory
memory.subtitle: What the bot remembers between chats.
memory.learnHint: Save facts it picks up in chat without asking
memory.learnFailed: Could not change how the bot learns.
memory.clearBody: The bot forgets everything it was told to remember. Its soul and instructions stay.
memory.empty: No facts yet. Add one below.
memory.addPlaceholder: Add a fact, e.g. Prefers squash merges
memory.loadFailed: Could not load what the bot remembers.
memory.sharedBy: Shared by another of your bots · {{date}}
memory.toLog: Look it up only when needed
memory.toProfile: Keep it in mind in every chat
memory.toPerson: Share it with all your bots

skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: Saved ways of doing a task. Run one by typing / and its name in the chat; the bot uses one on its own when a request fits.
skills.empty: No skills yet. Add one, or ask the bot to save how it did something as a skill.

dialog.description: A skill is a recipe the bot follows: when it applies, the steps, how to check the result and what to report.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. You run it as /{{name}}.
dialog.summaryHint: One sentence on what it does and when to use it. The bot reads this in every chat.
dialog.summaryPlaceholder: Writes release notes from the pull requests merged since the last tag
dialog.bodyPlaceholder:
1. List the pull requests merged since the last tag.
2. Group them by area.
3. Write the notes in Markdown and share them here.
dialog.userInvocable: I can run it from the chat with its command
dialog.modelInvocable: The bot can use it on its own when a request fits

skills.deleteBody: The bot can no longer use it, and /{{name}} stops working in the chat.

routines.title: Routines
routines.subtitle: Work the bot does on a schedule or when something happens.
routines.empty: Routines are tasks this bot runs on a schedule or when something happens. Ask it in chat to set one up.
routines.deleteBody: This deletes the routine and stops its future runs. This can't be undone.
routines.loadFailed: Could not load the bot's routines.

homeHost.title: Home host
homeHost.subtitle: Your bot always runs in Oppenheimer. When it starts a coding session and you haven't named a machine, the session runs here.
homeHost.noneHint: The bot asks which machine to use each time it starts a session.
homeHost.noHostsBody: A bot starts its coding sessions on a machine you own. Add one, then pick it here.
homeHost.failed: Could not change the home host.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.subtitle: What the bot does on its own, and what it asks you first.
permissions.loadFailed: Could not load the bot’s permissions.

preset.auto: Tools you leave on their default follow Approve for me: anything that reaches outside Oppenheimer asks first.
preset.full: Tools you leave on their default follow Full access: they run without asking.

permissions.perCall: Every call asks: it is never allowed for good.
permissions.noGrants: Nothing yet. “Always allow for …” on a request adds it here.

ask.title: Ask me first when
ask.hint: A matching request waits for you, even where the tool would run on its own.
ask.placeholder: e.g. it mentions payments or customer data

allow.title: Go ahead without asking when
allow.hint: A matching request runs without a card. An ask rule that also matches wins.
allow.placeholder: e.g. it comments on our docs repository

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.description: The bot, its instructions, its memory and its conversation are removed for good.
